visual_text: Illustrative drawing of a hospital tray. Figures are from Australian studies.
1. Cheese portion: about 4 in 10 healthy people over 65 could not open one
3. Milk, juice and cereal packs: about half of 140 mostly older patients found them difficult
4. In a lab test of 34 well older adults, opening a pack lying in bed took more finger strength than sitting in a chair
Bell et al., Appetite 2013, 2016; J Hum Nutr Diet 2017
alt_text: Annotated drawing of a hospital tray from above with numbered items: cheese portion (about 4 in 10 healthy over-65s could not open one), water bottle (1 in 10), milk, juice and cereal packs (about half of 140 patients struggled). Inset 4: an older woman in bed and an older man in a chair, with a lab finding that opening a pack in bed took more finger strength.
